key: For it is no vain thing for you; because it is your life, and through this thing ye shall prolong your days upon the land, whither ye go over the Jordan to possess it.
s: Moses, having finished the song, charges Israel to set their hearts on the law and teach it to their children; Rashi, on 32:47, reads it as saying that toil in the Torah is never for nothing, since much reward hangs on it.
